metadata.description: Yet another episode of Tribal Kitchen brings you a simple yet unique traditional recipe from Maharashtra. In this special edition, Mohini and Shilpa prepare a wholesome tribal dish for Shyam Sunder that is completely steamed — light on the stomach and free from guilt after eating. Healthy, nutritious, and easy to cook at home, this episode is not just about food but also offers a vibrant glimpse into colourful tribal life, culture, and the warmth of rural Maharashtra.
